visual_mood: Deep dark void, high-contrast typography, radar/terminal aesthetic with stark Signal Accents.

usage_rules.headings: MUST use IBM Plex Mono for H1/H2, tracking-tight, uppercase where appropriate (H4/Labels).
usage_rules.body: IBM Plex Sans for clean legibility on dense data views.
usage_rules.metrics: IBM Plex Mono for all numerical data, timestamps, statuses, and query inputs.
usage_rules.overline: IBM Plex Mono, text-xs, uppercase, tracking-[0.2em], text-terminal-amber.

layout_spacing.grid_strategy: MODE B: THE CONTROL ROOM GRID (For Dashboards/Analytics). grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4. gap-4 or gap-6.
layout_spacing.spacing_scale: Dense and compact for data, generous padding inside main content blocks. Use p-4, p-6.
layout_spacing.surface_strategy: GRID BORDERS (The 'Technical' Look). Expose the skeleton. border-collapse layouts, 1px subtle borders (border-terminal-border).
layout_spacing.borderRadius: none or max rounded-sm (2px) to maintain rigid terminal aesthetic. No pill-shaped buttons unless critical for contrast.

components.cards: Cardless design. Flat background (bg-terminal-surface), 1px solid border-terminal-border, no shadow. Hover: slight border color darken/lighten, no lift.
components.buttons: Square edges. Primary: bg-terminal-amber text-terminal-base hover:bg-yellow-400. Secondary: border border-terminal-border text-white hover:bg-terminal-surface hover:text-terminal-amber.
components.inputs: Flat, bg-transparent, border-b border-terminal-border or fully bordered with square edges. Focus: ring-1 ring-terminal-amber. Use textarea for long Google dork queries.
components.badges: Square, text-xs, font-mono. NEW badge: bg-terminal-amber/20 text-terminal-amber border border-terminal-amber/50.
components.tables: Dense. border-b for rows. font-mono for metrics. No alternating background colors, strictly border separated.
components.navigation: Left sidebar or sticky top header with glassmorphism (bg-black/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-terminal-border). Keep it stark.

motion.hover: Instant or 150ms ease. No bouncy animations.
motion.entrance: Fade in with subtle 5px Y-axis translate (duration 200ms).
motion.interactions: Focus rings must be stark Amber. Use data-testid for all interactive elements.

iconography.usage: Use stroke-width 1.5 or 2. Keep icons sharp and unembellished. Prefer terminal/radar metaphors (Activity, Crosshair, Terminal, Radio, Radar, Target).

radar_bg.description: Minimalist dark mode abstract background, subtle radar topography lines, high contrast stark white and amber glowing points on deep true black canvas, editorial terminal aesthetic.
radar_bg.usage: Login screen background, or masked over the top header for texture (opacity-20).

empty_state_data.description: Abstract minimalist data visualization, dark mode, geometric precision.
empty_state_data.usage: Use as an illustration for empty states (e.g., 'No queries monitored yet' or 'No new URLs discovered').

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement the UI with a strict dark mode (bg-[#050505]). Do NOT use generic Slate or Gray.
Fonts: Import IBM Plex Mono and IBM Plex Sans from Google Fonts. Apply them via Tailwind config.
Build the dashboard using a 'Control Room' dense grid.
Ensure all metric numbers, URLs, and status indicators use the monospace font.
The NEW badge for newly found URLs must be visually distinct, using the terminal amber color.
Data density is paramount. Avoid excessive padding; rely on borders to separate content.
All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
